review.why: Designs, configures, troubleshoots and reviews Cloudflare One Zero Trust deployments, including how scripts and agents authenticate to Access-protected apps.
review.summary: A workflow: classify the request, gather context, retrieve current docs, inspect existing resources before changing anything, and propose a change set with validation and rollback, staged to a pilot when risky. A section explains using Access service tokens for non-browser clients, with careful secret handling and warnings about sending credentials only to the intended host.
strengths: Inspect before changing, with rollback and pilot staging
Careful secret rules: never paste, log or forward service tokens
Explains why an Allow policy is not a Service Auth policy
cautions: Most detail comes from live docs and the account, not the skill
Later assessment prompts were not read in full
